visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair tied in a bun, wearing a red and white polka-dot romper, stands in a brightly lit indoor space. She holds a white rectangular package wrapped in bubble wrap, displaying an expression of extreme excitement with a wide-open mouth. Behind her, a black and white Mickey Mouse-themed illustration adorns the wall. (2) The woman brings the package closer to the lens, gesturing with her right hand which features red nails with white dots. A young child, also in a red polka-dot outfit, is visible to her left, watching the package. The camera is handheld, exhibiting minor movement. (3) A partial view of a male hand enters the frame from the bottom, interacting with the woman. She continues to smile and speak animatedly while clutching the wrapped item. (4) The woman begins unwrapping the package, peeling off the bubble wrap to reveal a white iPhone retail box. The child watches intently as the woman removes the plastic seal from the box. (5) Upon opening the box, a light purple smartphone is revealed. The woman turns the phone over to show the dual-camera lenses and the matte finish on the back. The camera zooms in for a close-up of the device's details. (6) The woman poses with the new phone near her face, expressing joy and surprise. The child reaches out to touch the phone as the woman continues her enthusiastic presentation.
